summary: The public contract permits at most 100 forwarded arguments, so the complete legal domain is too small for an honest runtime-scaling verdict; the wrapper forwards those arguments once and otherwise performs constant work.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The inputs array contains between zero and 100 values.

replacement_checks.evidence: Binding captures one function and one object in constant time. Each invocation stores a rest array of a values, installs one Symbol property, invokes the target once with one spread, and removes that property in a finally block.
Authored cases cover zero, one, several, and exactly 100 arguments; numbers, strings, and object results; argument order; nested reads; and mutation of the supplied context.
